'''Sapphire Lake''' was an artificial body of [[Water/Legends|water]] formed in [[Hollowtown]], on [[Centerpoint Station]], as a kind of nature preserve. Within the lake was a [[Forest/Legends|forested]] island that contained [[Eben Kinahay]]'s heavily defended [[Eben Kinahay's estate|estate]].<ref name="CatCW" /> In [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], the station's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] [[Destruction of TD-10036-EM-1271|fired]], causing the [[Glowpoint]] within Hollowtown to flare up to several thousand degrees. As a result, the water in Saphhire Lake evaporated.<ref name="SAC" /> At some point after, multiple parties would return to the island within the now former lake to look for a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] in what was left of Kinahay's estate.<ref name="CatCW" /> In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the remains of Sapphire Lake were destroyed completely, when the station's tractor beam targeted itself.<ref name="LotF: Fury" />
